claim: A fixed lightweight soft-score adapter can use a limited target-label budget to improve held-out Macro-F1 over same-pool majority voting.
anti_claims: This protocol is not a prospective confirmation because both datasets' labels had already been opened before it was written.
Repeated holdout intervals describe split variability and are not confidence intervals or hypothesis tests.
A positive result does not establish zero-shot transfer or universal superiority.

datasets.known_history: Labels and aggregate adaptation diagnostics were observed before this unified protocol.
Confirmation labels and aggregate prospective metrics were observed before this budget sweep; only split-specific budget outcomes remain uncomputed at protocol freeze.

sampling: uniform groups without replacement; deterministically resample until adaptation and evaluation partitions both contain safe and unsafe records

primary_method.features: logits of the three MMDS-calibrated unsafe probabilities
primary_method.threshold: maximize Macro-F1 on the adaptation subset only; break ties by unsafe recall then safe specificity

comparators: adapted_binary_judges with the same L2 logistic capacity and train-only threshold selection

reporting.uncertainty: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles across deterministic repeated group holdouts
